title: PolicyDecision
description: What the policy engine decided for a gesture (doctrine D-058, spec 112): allowed, to approve by someone, or refused — with the policies that decided it, their versions and why. A refusal wins over an approval, an approval over an allowance. What the policies on trial would have said is kept beside, never enforced.

approvers.description: Who must approve, when the effect is approve: the relations or roles of the policies that asked.

policies.description: The policies that decided. Empty for a refusal means nothing gave the power.

reason.description: The policy's sentence, as the person reads it on the card.

trial.description: The policies on trial that would have refused or asked, had they been active.
